Internal: the legends under a table of standardized coefficients

Source: R/models.R
dot-jst_beta_legends.Rd

The notes jlm() and jlogistic() print under their tables when a model holds interactions, powers or a product entered by hand: what the product method treats as an ordinary predictor, and what the centered methods change (Sessions 347 and 375). The two functions built them in one block each, the help page aside; Session 383 gave them one home.

Usage

.jst_beta_legends(
  std,
  beta_header,
  has_int,
  has_pow,
  pow_noun,
  hand,
  hand_sq,
  fn
)

Arguments

std

Character(1). The standardization method.

beta_header

Character(1). The column's header.

has_int, has_pow

Logical(1). Whether the formula holds an interaction, and a power.

pow_noun

Character(1). "squared term" or "power term".

hand

List. The products entered by hand, from .jst_hand_products().

hand_sq

Logical. Which of them square one variable.

fn

Character(1). The function whose help page the legends name.

Value

Character: the legends, possibly none.
